heightmap.decode: height = raw * height_scale + height_min; texel (i,j) centre at x = -4096 + (i + 0.5) * 2, z = -4096 + (j + 0.5) * 2

lakes.name: Veil of the Hundred Winds Pool

pois.name: Oasis of the Twin Koi
pois.description: A warm and impossible garden inside the palace tier, where two koi circle a moonlit pool. Waterbenders come here to feel the push and pull of the tides.

pois.name: Tidewarden Gate
pois.description: The eastern anchor of the great sea wall. From here the ice gate can be watched as it is bent open for friendly ships.

pois.name: Moonlit Ice Caves
pois.description: Tunnels melted into the snout of a glacier. Light filters blue through walls of ancient ice.

pois.name: The Frozen Cascade
pois.description: A waterfall caught mid-plunge by the polar cold, its icicles chiming whenever the wind turns.

pois.name: Agnaak Summit
pois.description: The highest of the polar peaks. On clear nights the whole tribe glitters below like frost on a bowl.

pois.name: Ruins of Old Qilak
pois.description: Snow-buried walls of a village abandoned when the ice shelf cracked away from the old coast.

pois.name: The Ice Flats
pois.description: A frozen lake swept smooth by the wind, where young benders drill forms until the ice sings.

pois.name: Shrine of the Pale Moon
pois.description: A ring of carved ice pillars on a windy headland, aligned so the full moon rises through the gate.

pois.name: Seal Hunters' Camp
pois.description: Hide tents and kayak racks on the ice shelf. Hunters trade stories for warm sea prune stew.

pois.name: The Crevasse Maze
pois.description: A field of knife-edged ice ridges and blue crevasses that shifts a little every winter.

pois.name: Whalebone Shelf
pois.description: The sheer edge of the eastern ice shelf, where the bones of a great whale-spirit are said to be frozen.

pois.name: Kayak Landing
pois.description: A sheltered cove where fishing kayaks are hauled onto the ice between storms.

pois.name: Aurora Ridge
pois.description: A wind-scoured crest where the southern lights seem close enough to touch.

pois.name: Lake of the Pale Moon
pois.description: A vast frozen lake whose ice is so clear that the moon appears twice.

pois.name: The Groaning Ice
pois.description: Pressure ridges on the frozen strait that grind and moan as the sea shifts underneath.

pois.name: Strait Wardens' Camp
pois.description: A waystation of the strait wardens, who guide travellers between the tundra and the north pole.

pois.name: Lantern Isle Lighthouse
pois.description: An old lighthouse kept burning by a hermit firebender who says she simply likes the quiet.

pois.name: Serpent's Watch
pois.description: A broken watchtower that once warned sailors of the great sea serpent. The serpent was not impressed.

pois.name: Misty Crag
pois.description: A lonely sea stack wrapped in fog, home to nesting cliff gulls and an unusually patient hermit crab.

pois.name: Turtle-crab Atoll
pois.description: A ring of white sand around a turquoise lagoon. Turtle-crabs gather here on the full moon.

pois.name: Frostfang Isle
pois.description: A frozen islet used as a lookout by whalers crossing the northern sea.

pois.name: Whalefall Skerries
pois.description: Low rocks rich with mussels and kelp, a favourite stop for hungry sailors.

pois.name: The Mail Chute Terraces
pois.description: Omashu's famous delivery chutes spiral down the terraces. Riding them is forbidden, which is why everyone does.

pois.name: Badgermole Tunnels
pois.description: Wide, smooth tunnels dug by the first earthbending teachers. The walls still hum when you listen through your feet.

pois.name: The Sundered Canyon
pois.description: A canyon split so deep that two rival tribes once needed a guide just to cross it.

pois.name: Red Mesa Lookout
pois.description: A flat-topped mesa with a view over the canyons all the way to the western sea.

pois.name: Millet Hollow
pois.description: A farming village of terraced fields and cabbage carts on the road to Omashu.

pois.name: Cedar Rest
pois.description: Woodcutters' homes built around an ancient cedar that the villagers refuse to fell.

pois.name: The Whispering Banyan
pois.description: A banyan tree whose roots spread for half a mile. Those who sit beneath it hear the whole forest breathe.

pois.name: Frostbitten Watchtower
pois.description: A crumbling Earth Kingdom watchtower that once kept an eye on the strait.

pois.name: Northreach Harbor
pois.description: A fishing harbour with ferries north to the Water Tribe when the sea ice allows.

pois.name: Full Moon Bay
pois.description: A crescent harbour town where ferries leave for the Fire Nation and the Air Temple foothills.

pois.name: Stonefist Training Yard
pois.description: A packed-earth yard outside the western wall where earthbenders practise their stances.

pois.name: Moonmirror Lake Pavilion
pois.description: A tiled pavilion on the shore of Moonmirror Lake, a favourite of travelling poets.

pois.name: Cloudpiercer Peak
pois.description: The tallest summit of the north-eastern range. On a clear day the Water Tribe's walls are visible.

pois.name: Dragonbone Arch
pois.description: A stone arch spanning the canyon, shaped like the spine of a sleeping dragon.

pois.name: Tunnels of the Two Lanterns
pois.description: A secret passage through the mountains, marked by two crystal lanterns that never go out.

pois.name: Jade Quarry
pois.description: Terraced cuts in green stone, worked by earthbenders for the Upper Ring's palaces.

pois.name: Dustwind Raider Camp
pois.description: Tents and stolen carts hidden among the mesas. The raiders are louder than they are dangerous.

pois.name: Mistveil Wetland
pois.description: Reed beds and drowned trees at the head of the eastern gulf, where spirits are said to walk in the fog.

pois.name: Thundering Steps
pois.description: A stair of cascades tumbling out of the north-eastern range.

pois.name: Jade Basin
pois.description: A deep green lake in the southern forest, cold even in high summer.

pois.name: Gate of the Agrarian Ring
pois.description: The great western gate of Ba Sing Se's outer wall, where farm carts queue at dawn.

pois.name: Plaza of the Sun
pois.description: A sun-baked plaza before the royal palace, its tiles warm even at midnight.

pois.name: Rim of the Sleeping Dragon
pois.description: A lookout on the caldera rim with the whole capital spread out in the crater below.

pois.name: Cinder Flats
pois.description: Black lava fields still cracked with glowing seams after the last eruption.

pois.name: The Burning Maw
pois.description: The rim of the active crater, where molten rock churns a few hundred feet below.

pois.name: Sunflare Isle Resort
pois.description: A resort of red-roofed villas and black-sand beaches where the nobility summers.

pois.name: Shrine of the Eternal Flame
pois.description: A brazier that has burned since the first firebenders learned from the dragons.

pois.name: Crimson Harbor Piers
pois.description: Piers of black stone and red lacquer where the navy and the ferries share an uneasy peace.

pois.name: Flame Kata Grounds
pois.description: A courtyard in the Noble Quarter scorched black by generations of drills.

pois.name: Overgrown Sun Temple
pois.description: A forgotten sun temple swallowed by the jungle. Its sundial still tells the hour.

pois.name: Obsidian Strand
pois.description: A beach of glittering black sand where waves hiss on warm stones.

pois.name: Saltspark Village
pois.description: A fishing village where lanterns are lit with a flick of the wrist.

pois.name: Ashleaf Tea Terraces
pois.description: Tea grown in volcanic soil on the southern slopes; the best leaf in the four nations, say the locals.

pois.name: Magma Tube Cavern
pois.description: A tunnel left by an ancient lava flow, its walls glassy and still faintly warm.

pois.name: Hissing Vents
pois.description: Steam vents that whistle in chords. Firebenders meditate here to steady their breath.

pois.name: The Dragon's Throat
pois.description: The gorge cut through the caldera wall, the only road between the capital and the harbour.

pois.name: Ember Veil Falls
pois.description: A jungle waterfall that glows orange at sunset as it spills over old lava cliffs.

pois.name: Southern Air Temple Sanctuary
pois.description: The heart of the temple, its towers crowned with blue roofs and spinning wind chimes.

pois.name: Sky Bison Stables
pois.description: Wide terraces where sky bison land, eat and nap in the sun.

pois.name: Bridge of Drifting Prayers
pois.description: A rope bridge hung with prayer flags, swaying out to a lonely pinnacle.

pois.name: Windchime Span
pois.description: A suspended bridge strung with chimes that play a different song for every wind.

pois.name: Veil of the Hundred Winds
pois.description: A waterfall so tall it turns to mist before it reaches the valley floor.

pois.name: Cloudspring Falls
pois.description: Snowmelt from the high cirque pouring off a granite lip.

pois.name: Meditation Ledge
pois.description: The top of a lonely pinnacle where monks sat for days to listen to the wind.

pois.name: Highwind Summit
pois.description: The highest summit of the southern peaks, buried in snow and silence.

pois.name: Gate of a Thousand Steps
pois.description: The foot of the switchback road that climbs to the temple. Pilgrims count every step.

pois.name: Foothills Landing
pois.description: A small pier where ferries from Full Moon Bay put in below the mountains.

pois.name: Airball Courts
pois.description: Poles and nets for airball, the monks' favourite (and most competitive) game.

pois.name: Glider's Leap
pois.description: A terrace edge with nothing beyond it but sky. Every young airbender's first flight starts here.

pois.name: Arch of the Four Winds
pois.description: A natural arch of pale granite where the four winds are said to meet.

pois.name: Whistling Wind Caves
pois.description: Caves that whistle like flutes when the south wind blows through them.

pois.name: Sky Cirque Pool
pois.description: A glacial pool cupped in a ring of peaks, perfectly still and impossibly blue.
